about: In the bustling metropolis of Houston, Texas, where legal complexities intertwine with personal lives, Bobby K. Newman stands as a beacon of hope and a formidable advocate at Bobby K. Newman, P.C. His name resonates with competence in all facets of family law, from navigating the intricate waters of high net worth divorce to fiercely protecting the rights and futures of children in custody and support battles.

Mr. Newman isn't just a lawyer; he's a seasoned navigator through the storms of family disputes. With a career etched in success stories, he has guided countless clients throughout the greater Houston metro region and its surrounding areas, offering them a lifeline in their most challenging times.

Known for his tenacity in the courtroom, Mr. Newman relentlessly pursues favorable outcomes for those he represents. His exceptional trial abilities have not gone unnoticed; the Houston Chronicle recognized him as one of Houston's Most Aggressive Divorce Lawyers, an accolade that speaks volumes about his dedication and skill. Beyond the courtroom, he is a skilled mediator and arbitrator, adept at steering parties toward amicable resolutions, saving them from the financial and emotional toll of drawn-out court battles.

An academic scholar, Mr. Newman’s journey began at The University of Texas at Austin, where he honed his analytical skills before delving into the legal realm at South Texas College of Law Houston, culminating in a Juris Doctor in 1994. That same year, he was admitted to the State Bar of Texas, marking the beginning of his impactful legal career. His proficiency extends to the U.S. District Courts for the Southern and Eastern Districts of Texas, showcasing his versatility and reach.

Mr. Newman's commitment to his field transcends his courtroom prowess. He is an active and influential member of the Family Law Section of the Houston Bar Association, where he has held several leadership roles. A thought leader and educator, he frequently shares his insights through articles and lectures, shaping the understanding of family law across the region. His knowledge is often sought by news media outlets, further solidifying his status as a leading authority.

A true consummate professional, Mr. Newman’s dedication to client satisfaction has been nationally recognized, with the American Institute of Family Law Attorneys naming him among the country's 10 Best in 2015. Houstonia magazine further honored him as one of the area's Top Lawyers in 2016, a testament to his unwavering commitment to excellence.
